name: Whuut's the Rush

angles.text: As an herbalist, you know that learning the properties of everyday plants such as speargrass and cattail matters as much as seeking rare blooms.
As a member of the Horde, you can learn from Yelmak’s patience and resourcefulness with local Kalimdor ingredients.

faq.answer: Whuut is Yelmak’s young apprentice and a gifted alchemist. Eager to experiment with rare herbs, he rushes past the trade’s fundamentals.
Yelmak is an experienced alchemist who mentors Whuut in the shop. He worries that the young alchemist is wasting precious supplies.

aliases: why does yelmak send the potion
faq.answer: Yelmak sends you with a tonic to teach Whuut patience and respect for the basics. He made it with speargrass and cattail, ordinary plants Whuut has been overlooking.
faq.q: Why does Yelmak send you with a potion for Whuut?

faq.answer: Yelmak used speargrass and cattail to brew the tonic. His careful method makes these common plants useful.
faq.q: What ingredients did Yelmak use in his potion?

faq.answer: Whuut was reaching for Black Lotus and Mountain Silversage. He had passed over everyday ingredients in favor of these rare plants.
faq.q: Which rare reagents was Whuut trying to work with?

faq.answer: After tasting the tonic and hearing its recipe, Whuut is surprised that common plants could make such a brew. He admits Yelmak is right and resolves to pay closer attention to the everyday plants he had dismissed.

sections.body: Whuut has a gift for alchemy, and the stirring rod comes naturally to him. Yet impatience leads him to spend the shop’s rarest reagents before he has mastered the basics. He reaches for legendary plants before learning how common herbs must be balanced, treating alchemy as a race.
sections.title: The Eager Prodigy

sections.body: Yelmak answers his apprentice’s haste with a lesson in a vial. He brews a refined tonic from common speargrass and cattail using a quick method. Whuut is daydreaming about Black Lotus and Mountain Silversage when the tonic reaches his hands. Its simple ingredients show how much skill, patience, and respect for everyday plants can matter.
sections.title: A Lesson in a Vial

summary: Yelmak sends you to carry a tonic to Whuut, whose eagerness has outrun his care. His apprentice reaches for rare herbs before learning what common plants can do.
